issuerAlsoKnownAs.name: Sample Conformity Assessment Services Pty Ltd

credentialSubject.name: Coppermark Responsible Production Certificate — Sample Mine
credentialSubject.description: Third-party conformity assessment of Sample Copper Mine against Coppermark Responsible Risk Assessment (RRA) v3.0, covering environmental, social, and governance criteria for responsible copper production.

authorisation.name: Accreditation of Sample Conformity Assessment Body as a Coppermark Approved Assessment Firm.

trustmark.name: Coppermark Approved Assessor
trustmark.description: Trust mark issued by The Copper Mark Company to accredited assessment firms.

profileScore.definition: The site fully meets all applicable Coppermark criteria with no significant non-conformances.

conformityCertificate.linkName: Coppermark Public Certificate — Sample Copper Mine Pty Ltd

trustmark.name: Coppermark Certified
trustmark.description: The Copper Mark — responsible production trust mark for copper, molybdenum, nickel, and zinc.

conformityAssessment.name: GHG Emissions Assessment (Criteria 26, 27)
conformityAssessment.description: Assessment of greenhouse gas emissions management, measurement, and reduction initiatives at Sample Copper Mine against Coppermark criteria 26 (GHG Emissions) and 27 (Energy Use and Efficiency).

conformityTopic.name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions
conformityTopic.definition: Assessment of direct and indirect greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3, including measurement, reporting, and reduction targets aligned with climate science.

assessmentCriteria.name: Energy Use and Efficiency — Coppermark Criterion 27

conformityTopic.name: Renewable Energy Use
conformityTopic.definition: Adoption and integration of renewable energy sources to reduce reliance on fossil fuels and lower the carbon footprint of operations and products.

conformityAssessment.name: No Forced Labor Assessment (Criterion 12)
conformityAssessment.description: Assessment of forced labor elimination practices at Sample Copper Mine against Coppermark criterion 12 (Forced Labour).

conformityTopic.name: Forced Labor Elimination
conformityTopic.definition: Policies and practices to identify, prevent, and remediate forced labor, including debt bondage, trafficking, and involuntary work, throughout the supply chain.

conformityAssessment.name: Water Stewardship Assessment (Criterion 28)
conformityAssessment.description: Assessment of water stewardship practices at Sample Copper Mine against Coppermark criterion 28 (Water Stewardship).

conformityTopic.name: Water Conservation
conformityTopic.definition: Efficient and responsible management of water resources, including reduction of water consumption, recycling, and protection of water quality in operations and supply chains.
